title: Panorama Creator
description: A simple client-side mod that allows you to easily capture and create custom main menu panoramas directly from the game.
body:
# Panorama Creator
**Panorama Creator** is a lightweight, client-side Fabric mod that makes creating custom main menu panoramas incredibly easy! No more manual screenshotting, cropping, or dealing with complex folder structures — the mod does everything for you.

## ✨ Features
* **One-Click Capture:** Simply press a hotkey to instantly capture a perfect 360-degree panorama of your current surroundings.
* **Custom Names:** Give your panoramas custom names through an in-game GUI so you can easily organize multiple backgrounds.
* **Automatic Resource Pack Generation:** The mod automatically compiles the captured screenshots into a ready-to-use Minecraft resource pack.
* **No Dependencies:** This mod is fully standalone and **does NOT require the Fabric API** to work!

## 🎮 How to use
1. Find a beautiful spot in your Minecraft world.
2. Press **`F1 + K`** (default keybind) to open the Panorama Creator menu.
3. Enter a custom name for your new panorama and click **Create**.
4. The mod will quickly hide your GUI, adjust your FOV, take 6 precise screenshots, and generate a resource pack.
5. Go to **Options -> Resource Packs...** and enable your newly created panorama pack.
6. Return to the main menu and enjoy your custom background!

## ⚙️ Installation
Just drop the `.jar` file into your `mods` folder. You only need the standard Fabric Loader. (Fabric API is not required).

*Note: Since this is a purely client-side mod, it works perfectly on multiplayer servers and realms!*
